name: Chelac Elixir
description: Blending the seeds of the Cheri berries with the juices of the Salac berry, then heating them over a firm boil can bring out the maximum curiative potential of the Cheri Berries.
effect: Cure Paralysis and become immune to Paralysis for the rest of the scene. Gain +1 Dexterity for the rest of the scene.
